title: Remove 60 native maps and 42 more ADDs after PR5350; kappa unchanged
body:
This exact circuit improvement removes **60 native-map records and 42 additional scalar ADD records per native call** after [PR #5350](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5350). The native-map count falls from 240 to 180. Scalar allowance falls by another 236 per call: forward 156904 → 156668, backward 156952 → 156716. These are circuit counts, not measured running times.

**Kappa is unchanged.** Every paid Gaussian record and all 408 independent helper boundaries are retained. The complete recursive moment and its binding main-transform cost are unchanged. The selected record is not edited.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff78b33a8c5327199af63325b0d4ee80c65b429d/research/native-gauge-cancellation/PROOF.md), [deterministic result and event patch](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff78b33a8c5327199af63325b0d4ee80c65b429d/research/native-gauge-cancellation/RESULT.json), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff78b33a8c5327199af63325b0d4ee80c65b429d/research/native-gauge-cancellation/SOURCES.json), and [validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff78b33a8c5327199af63325b0d4ee80c65b429d/research/native-gauge-cancellation/VALIDATION.md).

The pass tracks rational scalar factors and formal native-map words before comparing ADDs. It combines exact equal operators across commuting instructions and removes native maps that become an unused inverse pair. Source writes, target reads and resets remain barriers. The generated word has 193 fewer scalar records and 60 fewer native maps than the original final PR4610 word; the earlier 151 scalar deletions remain predecessor credit.

The base and all consumed source files are pinned to canonical main `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`. The source manifest includes the exact constructor and both retained native interpreters. No predecessor file or frozen archive is changed.

Run with Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/native-gauge-cancellation
```

The scientific command reports:

```text
PASS_NATIVE_GAUGE_CANCELLATION_NO_KAPPA_CHANGE
```

Passed locally: registered replay, isolated optimized replay, both retained interpreters on all 632 arbitrary persistent columns in both orientations, owned return, exact frame checks, complete local invoices, actual scalar-sign mutation rejection, committed-byte and export checks, and a fresh Git-free optimized replay with PATH=/nonexistent. The final commit adds validation text only. Hosted CI is pending at submission.

Existing absolute-phase recipes are reused; no new paid edge or monomial operator is introduced. The full phase suite, cold selected replay, complete controller/compiler/BIT/outer ledger and formal kernel were not rerun. The five selected framework assumptions remain; independent human review is open.

Credit Cao Yifan's [PR #4610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4610) native word, Cinna Davis's [PR #4692](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4692) rewrites, ahrazzle's [PR #5350](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5350) composition, and Chrisbryan17's earlier [PR #5265](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5265) inverse-pair check. The [retained contributor map](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4/docs/research/community-native4610-contributors.md) records the native/helper/compiler lineage, including Dugongue, zxv and Jacob Alan Sussman. Both native interpreters are reused implementations, not new independent checkers. New work by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
